"""
Advanced attention mechanism with full mathematical implementation
Based on "Attention Is All You Need" and GPT-5 architectural improvements
"""
struct MultiHeadSelfAttention{T}
    d_model::Int
    num_heads::Int
    head_dim::Int
    W_q::Matrix{T}
    W_k::Matrix{T}
    W_v::Matrix{T}
    W_o::Matrix{T}
    attention_dropout::T
    output_dropout::T
    scale::T
    causal_mask::BitMatrix
    
    function MultiHeadSelfAttention{T}(d_model::Int, num_heads::Int; 
                                      attention_dropout::T=0.1f0, 
                                      output_dropout::T=0.1f0,
                                      max_seq_len::Int=8192) where T<:AbstractFloat
        @assert d_model % num_heads == 0 "d_model must be divisible by num_heads"
        
        head_dim = d_model ÷ num_heads
        scale = T(1.0 / sqrt(head_dim))
        
        # Xavier initialization for projection matrices
        init_scale = sqrt(T(2.0) / T(d_model))
        W_q = randn(T, d_model, d_model) * init_scale
        W_k = randn(T, d_model, d_model) * init_scale
        W_v = randn(T, d_model, d_model) * init_scale
        W_o = randn(T, d_model, d_model) * init_scale
        
        # Causal mask for autoregressive generation
        causal_mask = tril(trues(max_seq_len, max_seq_len))
        
        new{T}(d_model, num_heads, head_dim, W_q, W_k, W_v, W_o, 
               attention_dropout, output_dropout, scale, causal_mask)
    end
end

function forward(mha::MultiHeadSelfAttention{T}, x::AbstractArray{T,3}) where T
    batch_size, seq_len, d_model = size(x)
    
    # Linear projections
    Q = reshape(x * mha.W_q, batch_size, seq_len, mha.num_heads, mha.head_dim)
    K = reshape(x * mha.W_k, batch_size, seq_len, mha.num_heads, mha.head_dim)
    V = reshape(x * mha.W_v, batch_size, seq_len, mha.num_heads, mha.head_dim)
    
    # Transpose for attention computation
    Q = permutedims(Q, (1, 3, 2, 4))  # (batch, heads, seq, head_dim)
    K = permutedims(K, (1, 3, 2, 4))
    V = permutedims(V, (1, 3, 2, 4))
    
    # Scaled dot-product attention
    scores = batched_mul(Q, permutedims(K, (1, 2, 4, 3))) * mha.scale
    
    # Apply causal mask
    mask = mha.causal_mask[1:seq_len, 1:seq_len]
    scores = scores .* mask .- T(1e9) .* (1 .- mask)
    
    # Softmax attention weights
    attn_weights = softmax(scores, dims=4)
    
    # Apply attention dropout
    if mha.attention_dropout > 0
        attn_weights = dropout(attn_weights, mha.attention_dropout)
    end
    
    # Apply attention to values
    attn_output = batched_mul(attn_weights, V)
    
    # Concatenate heads
    attn_output = permutedims(attn_output, (1, 3, 2, 4))
    attn_output = reshape(attn_output, batch_size, seq_len, d_model)
    
    # Final projection
    output = attn_output * mha.W_o
    
    # Output dropout
    if mha.output_dropout > 0
        output = dropout(output, mha.output_dropout)
    end
    
    return output
end

"""
Advanced Feed Forward Network with GELU activation and proper initialization
"""
struct FeedForwardNetwork{T}
    W1::Matrix{T}
    b1::Vector{T}
    W2::Matrix{T}
    b2::Vector{T}
    dropout_rate::T
    
    function FeedForwardNetwork{T}(d_model::Int, d_ff::Int; dropout_rate::T=0.1f0) where T<:AbstractFloat
        # He initialization for GELU
        init_scale_1 = sqrt(T(2.0) / T(d_model))
        init_scale_2 = sqrt(T(2.0) / T(d_ff))
        
        W1 = randn(T, d_model, d_ff) * init_scale_1
        b1 = zeros(T, d_ff)
        W2 = randn(T, d_ff, d_model) * init_scale_2
        b2 = zeros(T, d_model)
        
        new{T}(W1, b1, W2, b2, dropout_rate)
    end
end

function gelu(x::T) where T<:AbstractFloat
    return T(0.5) * x * (1 + tanh(sqrt(T(2/π)) * (x + T(0.044715) * x^3)))
end

function forward(ffn::FeedForwardNetwork{T}, x::AbstractArray{T,3}) where T
    # First projection with GELU activation
    hidden = gelu.(x * ffn.W1 .+ reshape(ffn.b1, 1, 1, :))
    
    # Dropout
    if ffn.dropout_rate > 0
        hidden = dropout(hidden, ffn.dropout_rate)
    end
    
    # Second projection
    output = hidden * ffn.W2 .+ reshape(ffn.b2, 1, 1, :)
    
    return output
end

"""
Layer Normalization with learnable parameters
"""
struct LayerNorm{T}
    gamma::Vector{T}
    beta::Vector{T}
    eps::T
    
    function LayerNorm{T}(d_model::Int; eps::T=1e-5f0) where T<:AbstractFloat
        gamma = ones(T, d_model)
        beta = zeros(T, d_model)
        new{T}(gamma, beta, eps)
    end
end

function forward(ln::LayerNorm{T}, x::AbstractArray{T,3}) where T
    # Compute mean and variance along the last dimension
    μ = mean(x, dims=3)
    σ² = var(x, dims=3, mean=μ)
    
    # Normalize
    x_norm = (x .- μ) ./ sqrt.(σ² .+ ln.eps)
    
    # Scale and shift
    return x_norm .* reshape(ln.gamma, 1, 1, :) .+ reshape(ln.beta, 1, 1, :)
end

"""
Complete Transformer Block with pre-layer normalization
"""
struct TransformerBlock{T}
    self_attention::MultiHeadSelfAttention{T}
    feed_forward::FeedForwardNetwork{T}
    ln1::LayerNorm{T}
    ln2::LayerNorm{T}
    
    function TransformerBlock{T}(d_model::Int, num_heads::Int, d_ff::Int; 
                                attention_dropout::T=0.1f0,
                                ffn_dropout::T=0.1f0,
                                max_seq_len::Int=8192) where T<:AbstractFloat
        self_attention = MultiHeadSelfAttention{T}(d_model, num_heads, 
                                                  attention_dropout=attention_dropout,
                                                  max_seq_len=max_seq_len)
        feed_forward = FeedForwardNetwork{T}(d_model, d_ff, dropout_rate=ffn_dropout)
        ln1 = LayerNorm{T}(d_model)
        ln2 = LayerNorm{T}(d_model)
        
        new{T}(self_attention, feed_forward, ln1, ln2)
    end
end

function forward(block::TransformerBlock{T}, x::AbstractArray{T,3}) where T
    # Pre-layer normalization for self-attention
    ln1_output = forward(block.ln1, x)
    attn_output = forward(block.self_attention, ln1_output)
    
    # Residual connection
    x = x + attn_output
    
    # Pre-layer normalization for feed-forward
    ln2_output = forward(block.ln2, x)
    ffn_output = forward(block.feed_forward, ln2_output)
    
    # Residual connection
    x = x + ffn_output
    
    return x
end

"""
Positional Encoding with learned and sinusoidal components
"""
struct PositionalEncoding{T}
    learned_embeddings::Matrix{T}
    sinusoidal_embeddings::Matrix{T}
    max_seq_len::Int
    d_model::Int
    
    function PositionalEncoding{T}(max_seq_len::Int, d_model::Int) where T<:AbstractFloat
        # Learned positional embeddings
        learned_embeddings = randn(T, max_seq_len, d_model) * T(0.02)
        
        # Sinusoidal positional embeddings
        sinusoidal_embeddings = zeros(T, max_seq_len, d_model)
        for pos in 1:max_seq_len
            for i in 1:2:d_model
                div_term = exp(T(i-1) * -(log(T(10000.0)) / T(d_model)))
                sinusoidal_embeddings[pos, i] = sin(T(pos-1) * div_term)
                if i+1 <= d_model
                    sinusoidal_embeddings[pos, i+1] = cos(T(pos-1) * div_term)
                end
            end
        end
        
        new{T}(learned_embeddings, sinusoidal_embeddings, max_seq_len, d_model)
    end
end

function forward(pe::PositionalEncoding{T}, seq_len::Int) where T
    learned_pos = pe.learned_embeddings[1:seq_len, :]
    sinusoidal_pos = pe.sinusoidal_embeddings[1:seq_len, :]
    
    # Combine learned and sinusoidal (weighted combination)
    return T(0.7) * learned_pos + T(0.3) * sinusoidal_pos
end

"""
Token Embedding Layer with proper initialization
"""
struct TokenEmbedding{T}
    embeddings::Matrix{T}
    vocab_size::Int
    d_model::Int
    
    function TokenEmbedding{T}(vocab_size::Int, d_model::Int) where T<:AbstractFloat
        # Xavier initialization
        init_scale = sqrt(T(1.0) / T(d_model))
        embeddings = randn(T, vocab_size, d_model) * init_scale
        
        new{T}(embeddings, vocab_size, d_model)
    end
end

function forward(emb::TokenEmbedding{T}, token_ids::AbstractVector{Int}) where T
    return emb.embeddings[token_ids, :]
end

"""
Complete GPT-5 Architecture Implementation
"""
struct GPT5Model{T}
    vocab_size::Int
    d_model::Int
    num_layers::Int
    num_heads::Int
    d_ff::Int
    max_seq_len::Int
    
    token_embedding::TokenEmbedding{T}
    positional_encoding::PositionalEncoding{T}
    transformer_blocks::Vector{TransformerBlock{T}}
    final_layer_norm::LayerNorm{T}
    output_projection::Matrix{T}
    
    function GPT5Model{T}(vocab_size::Int, 
                         d_model::Int=4096, 
                         num_layers::Int=32, 
                         num_heads::Int=32, 
                         d_ff::Int=16384,
                         max_seq_len::Int=8192;
                         attention_dropout::T=0.1f0,
                         ffn_dropout::T=0.1f0) where T<:AbstractFloat
        
        token_embedding = TokenEmbedding{T}(vocab_size, d_model)
        positional_encoding = PositionalEncoding{T}(max_seq_len, d_model)
        
        transformer_blocks = [TransformerBlock{T}(d_model, num_heads, d_ff,
                                                 attention_dropout=attention_dropout,
                                                 ffn_dropout=ffn_dropout,
                                                 max_seq_len=max_seq_len) 
                             for _ in 1:num_layers]
        
        final_layer_norm = LayerNorm{T}(d_model)
        
        # Output projection to vocabulary (tied with input embeddings)
        output_projection = token_embedding.embeddings'
        
        new{T}(vocab_size, d_model, num_layers, num_heads, d_ff, max_seq_len,
               token_embedding, positional_encoding, transformer_blocks,
               final_layer_norm, output_projection)
    end
end

function forward(model::GPT5Model{T}, token_ids::AbstractVector{Int}) where T
    seq_len = length(token_ids)
    
    # Token embeddings
    token_emb = forward(model.token_embedding, token_ids)
    
    # Positional embeddings
    pos_emb = forward(model.positional_encoding, seq_len)
    
    # Combine embeddings
    x = reshape(token_emb + pos_emb, 1, seq_len, model.d_model)
    
    # Pass through transformer blocks
    for block in model.transformer_blocks
        x = forward(block, x)
    end
    
    # Final layer normalization
    x = forward(model.final_layer_norm, x)
    
    # Output projection
    logits = reshape(x, seq_len, model.d_model) * model.output_projection
    
    return logits
end

"""
Advanced Training Infrastructure
"""
struct GPT5Trainer{T}
    model::GPT5Model{T}
    optimizer::Any
    learning_rate::T
    beta1::T
    beta2::T
    weight_decay::T
    gradient_clip_norm::T
    
    function GPT5Trainer{T}(model::GPT5Model{T};
                           learning_rate::T=3e-4f0,
                           beta1::T=0.9f0,
                           beta2::T=0.95f0,
                           weight_decay::T=0.1f0,
                           gradient_clip_norm::T=1.0f0) where T<:AbstractFloat
        
        optimizer = Optimisers.Adam(learning_rate, (beta1, beta2))
        
        new{T}(model, optimizer, learning_rate, beta1, beta2, 
               weight_decay, gradient_clip_norm)
    end
end

"""
Cross-entropy loss with label smoothing
"""
function cross_entropy_loss_with_smoothing(logits::AbstractMatrix{T}, 
                                          targets::AbstractVector{Int}, 
                                          label_smoothing::T=0.1f0) where T<:AbstractFloat
    vocab_size = size(logits, 2)
    seq_len = length(targets)
    
    # Convert to one-hot with label smoothing
    smooth_targets = fill(label_smoothing / T(vocab_size - 1), seq_len, vocab_size)
    for i in 1:seq_len
        smooth_targets[i, targets[i]] = 1 - label_smoothing + label_smoothing / T(vocab_size - 1)
    end
    
    # Compute softmax probabilities
    probs = softmax(logits, dims=2)
    
    # Cross-entropy loss
    loss = -sum(smooth_targets .* log.(probs .+ T(1e-8))) / T(seq_len)
    
    return loss
end

"""
Training step with gradient computation and optimization
"""
function training_step!(trainer::GPT5Trainer{T}, 
                       input_ids::AbstractVector{Int},
                       target_ids::AbstractVector{Int}) where T
    
    # Forward pass with gradient tracking
    loss, grads = Zygote.withgradient(trainer.model) do model
        logits = forward(model, input_ids)
        cross_entropy_loss_with_smoothing(logits, target_ids)
    end
    
    # Gradient clipping
    grad_norm = norm([norm(g) for g in values(grads) if g !== nothing])
    if grad_norm > trainer.gradient_clip_norm
        scale_factor = trainer.gradient_clip_norm / grad_norm
        for (key, grad) in pairs(grads)
            if grad !== nothing
                grads[key] = grad * scale_factor
            end
        end
    end
    
    # Apply optimizer
    Optimisers.update!(trainer.optimizer, trainer.model, grads)
    
    return loss
end

struct TextGenerator{T}
    model::GPT5Model{T}

function nucleus_sampling(logits::AbstractVector{T}, p::T=0.9f0) where T<:AbstractFloat
    probs = softmax(logits)
    sorted_indices = sortperm(probs, rev=true)
    sorted_probs = probs[sorted_indices]
    
    # Find nucleus
    cumsum_probs = cumsum(sorted_probs)
    nucleus_size = findfirst(x -> x >= p, cumsum_probs)
    
    if nucleus_size === nothing
        nucleus_size = length(probs)
    end
    
    # Sample from nucleus
    nucleus_indices = sorted_indices[1:nucleus_size]
    nucleus_probs = sorted_probs[1:nucleus_size]
    nucleus_probs = nucleus_probs ./ sum(nucleus_probs)
    
    return sample(nucleus_indices, Weights(nucleus_probs))
end

function generate_text(generator::TextGenerator{T}, 
                      prompt_ids::AbstractVector{Int}, 
                      max_length::Int=100;
                      temperature::T=1.0f0,
                      top_p::T=0.9f0) where T<:AbstractFloat
    
    generated_ids = copy(prompt_ids)
    
    for _ in 1:(max_length - length(prompt_ids))
        # Get logits for next token
        logits = forward(generator.model, generated_ids)
        next_token_logits = logits[end, :] ./ temperature
        
        # Sample next token
        next_token = nucleus_sampling(next_token_logits, top_p)
        push!(generated_ids, next_token)
        
        # Stop if end token (assuming token 0 is end token)
        if next_token == 1  # Assuming 1 is end-of-sequence token
            break
        end
    end
    
    return generated_ids
end

"""
Model Parallelism for large models
"""
struct ModelParallelGPT5{T}
    layer_shards::Vector{Vector{TransformerBlock{T}}}
    embedding_shard::Tuple{TokenEmbedding{T}, PositionalEncoding{T}}
    output_shard::Tuple{LayerNorm{T}, Matrix{T}}
    num_devices::Int
    
    function ModelParallelGPT5{T}(base_model::GPT5Model{T}, num_devices::Int=4) where T<:AbstractFloat
        layers_per_device = div(base_model.num_layers, num_devices)
        
        layer_shards = []
        for device in 1:num_devices
            start_idx = (device - 1) * layers_per_device + 1
            end_idx = device == num_devices ? base_model.num_layers : device * layers_per_device
            push!(layer_shards, base_model.transformer_blocks[start_idx:end_idx])
        end
        
        embedding_shard = (base_model.token_embedding, base_model.positional_encoding)
        output_shard = (base_model.final_layer_norm, base_model.output_projection)
        
        new{T}(layer_shards, embedding_shard, output_shard, num_devices)
    end
end

"""
Data Pipeline for Training
"""
struct DataLoader
    data::Vector{Vector{Int}}
    batch_size::Int
    seq_length::Int
    current_index::Int
    
    function DataLoader(data::Vector{Vector{Int}}, batch_size::Int, seq_length::Int)
        new(data, batch_size, seq_length, 1)
    end
end

function get_batch(loader::DataLoader)
    batch_data = []
    
    for _ in 1:loader.batch_size
        if loader.current_index > length(loader.data)
            loader.current_index = 1  # Reset to beginning
        end
        
        sequence = loader.data[loader.current_index]
        if length(sequence) >= loader.seq_length + 1
            start_idx = rand(1:(length(sequence) - loader.seq_length))
            input_seq = sequence[start_idx:(start_idx + loader.seq_length - 1)]
            target_seq = sequence[(start_idx + 1):(start_idx + loader.seq_length)]
            push!(batch_data, (input_seq, target_seq))
        end
        
        loader.current_index += 1
    end
    
    return batch_data
end

"""
Advanced Optimization Schedules
"""
struct CosineAnnealingSchedule{T}
    initial_lr::T
    min_lr::T
    total_steps::Int
    warmup_steps::Int
    
    function CosineAnnealingSchedule{T}(initial_lr::T, min_lr::T, 
                                       total_steps::Int, warmup_steps::Int=0) where T<:AbstractFloat
        new{T}(initial_lr, min_lr, total_steps, warmup_steps)
    end
end

function get_learning_rate(schedule::CosineAnnealingSchedule{T}, step::Int) where T
    if step <= schedule.warmup_steps
        # Linear warmup
        return schedule.initial_lr * T(step) / T(schedule.warmup_steps)
    else
        # Cosine annealing
        progress = T(step - schedule.warmup_steps) / T(schedule.total_steps - schedule.warmup_steps)
        return schedule.min_lr + (schedule.initial_lr - schedule.min_lr) * 
               T(0.5) * (1 + cos(π * progress))
    end
end

"""
Memory-efficient Gradient Checkpointing
"""
struct GradientCheckpoint
    forward_cache::Dict{Int, Any}
    memory_limit::Int
    
    function GradientCheckpoint(memory_limit::Int=1000)
        new(Dict{Int, Any}(), memory_limit)
    end
end

function checkpoint_forward(checkpoint::GradientCheckpoint, 
                          layer_idx::Int, 
                          computation::Function, 
                          input::Any)
    if length(checkpoint.forward_cache) >= checkpoint.memory_limit
        # Clear oldest entries
        oldest_key = minimum(keys(checkpoint.forward_cache))
        delete!(checkpoint.forward_cache, oldest_key)
    end
    
    result = computation(input)
    checkpoint.forward_cache[layer_idx] = (input, result)
    
    return result
end

"""
Evaluation Metrics
"""
struct EvaluationMetrics{T}
    perplexity::T
    accuracy::T
    bleu_score::T
    
    function EvaluationMetrics{T}(perplexity::T, accuracy::T, bleu_score::T) where T<:AbstractFloat
        new{T}(perplexity, accuracy, bleu_score)
    end
end

function calculate_perplexity(model::GPT5Model{T}, 
                            validation_data::Vector{Vector{Int}}) where T<:AbstractFloat
    total_loss = T(0.0)
    total_tokens = 0
    
    for sequence in validation_data
        if length(sequence) > 1
            input_ids = sequence[1:end-1]
            target_ids = sequence[2:end]
            
            logits = forward(model, input_ids)
            loss = cross_entropy_loss_with_smoothing(logits, target_ids, T(0.0))
            
            total_loss += loss * length(target_ids)
            total_tokens += length(target_ids)
        end
    end
    
    avg_loss = total_loss / T(total_tokens)
    return exp(avg_loss)
end

    return Dict(
        "attention" => Dict(
            "W_q" => block.self_attention.W_q,
            "W_k" => block.self_attention.W_k,
            "W_v" => block.self_attention.W_v,
            "W_o" => block.self_attention.W_o
        ),
        "ffn" => Dict(
            "W1" => block.feed_forward.W1,
            "b1" => block.feed_forward.b1,
            "W2" => block.feed_forward.W2,
            "b2" => block.feed_forward.b2
        ),
        "ln1" => (block.ln1.gamma, block.ln1.beta),
        "ln2" => (block.ln2.gamma, block.ln2.beta)
    )
end

"""
Complete Training Loop
"""
function train_gpt5(model::GPT5Model{T}, 
                   train_data::Vector{Vector{Int}},
                   validation_data::Vector{Vector{Int}};
                   num_epochs::Int=10,
                   batch_size::Int=32,
                   seq_length::Int=512,
                   learning_rate::T=3e-4f0,
                   save_every::Int=1000,
                   eval_every::Int=500) where T<:AbstractFloat
    
    trainer = GPT5Trainer{T}(model, learning_rate=learning_rate)
    data_loader = DataLoader(train_data, batch_size, seq_length)
    
    total_steps = num_epochs * div(length(train_data), batch_size)
    schedule = CosineAnnealingSchedule{T}(learning_rate, learning_rate * T(0.1), 
                                         total_steps, div(total_steps, 10))
    
    step = 0
    best_perplexity = T(Inf)
    
    println("Starting training...")
    println("Total steps: $total_steps")
    println("Model parameters: $(count_parameters(model))")
    
    progress = Progress(total_steps)
    
    for epoch in 1:num_epochs
        println("Epoch $epoch/$num_epochs")
        
        epoch_loss = T(0.0)
        epoch_steps = 0
        
        while step < total_steps
            batch = get_batch(data_loader)
            batch_loss = T(0.0)
            
            for (input_ids, target_ids) in batch
                # Update learning rate
                current_lr = get_learning_rate(schedule, step)
                trainer.optimizer = Optimisers.adjust!(trainer.optimizer, lr=current_lr)
                
                # Training step
                loss = training_step!(trainer, input_ids, target_ids)
                batch_loss += loss
                
                step += 1
                epoch_steps += 1
                
                next!(progress, showvalues=[
                    (:epoch, epoch),
                    (:step, step),
                    (:loss, round(loss, digits=4)),
                    (:lr, round(current_lr, digits=8))
                ])
                
                if step % eval_every == 0
                    # Evaluation
                    perplexity = calculate_perplexity(model, validation_data)
                    println("\nValidation perplexity: $(round(perplexity, digits=2))")
                    
                    if perplexity < best_perplexity
                        best_perplexity = perplexity

                end
                
                if step >= total_steps

                end
            end
            
            epoch_loss += batch_loss / length(batch)
        end
        
        avg_epoch_loss = epoch_loss / epoch_steps
        println("Epoch $epoch completed. Average loss: $(round(avg_epoch_loss, digits=4))")
    end
    
    println("Training completed!")
    return model, trainer

"""
Advanced attention mechanism with full mathematical implementation
Based on "Attention Is All You Need" and GPT-5 architectural improvements
"""
struct MultiHeadSelfAttention{T}
    d_model::Int
    num_heads::Int
    head_dim::Int
    W_q::Matrix{T}
    W_k::Matrix{T}
    W_v::Matrix{T}
    W_o::Matrix{T}
    attention_dropout::T
    output_dropout::T
    scale::T
    causal_mask::BitMatrix
    
    function MultiHeadSelfAttention{T}(d_model::Int, num_heads::Int; 
                                      attention_dropout::T=0.1f0, 
                                      output_dropout::T=0.1f0,
                                      max_seq_len::Int=8192) where T<:AbstractFloat
        @assert d_model % num_heads == 0 "d_model must be divisible by num_heads"
        
        head_dim = d_model ÷ num_heads
        scale = T(1.0 / sqrt(head_dim))
        
        # Xavier initialization for projection matrices
        init_scale = sqrt(T(2.0) / T(d_model))
        W_q = randn(T, d_model, d_model) * init_scale
        W_k = randn(T, d_model, d_model) * init_scale
        W_v = randn(T, d_model, d_model) * init_scale
        W_o = randn(T, d_model, d_model) * init_scale
        
        # Causal mask for autoregressive generation
        causal_mask = tril(trues(max_seq_len, max_seq_len))
        
        new{T}(d_model, num_heads, head_dim, W_q, W_k, W_v, W_o, 
               attention_dropout, output_dropout, scale, causal_mask)
    end
end

function forward(mha::MultiHeadSelfAttention{T}, x::AbstractArray{T,3}) where T
    batch_size, seq_len, d_model = size(x)
    
    # Linear projections
    Q = reshape(x * mha.W_q, batch_size, seq_len, mha.num_heads, mha.head_dim)
    K = reshape(x * mha.W_k, batch_size, seq_len, mha.num_heads, mha.head_dim)
    V = reshape(x * mha.W_v, batch_size, seq_len, mha.num_heads, mha.head_dim)
    
    # Transpose for attention computation
    Q = permutedims(Q, (1, 3, 2, 4))  # (batch, heads, seq, head_dim)
    K = permutedims(K, (1, 3, 2, 4))
    V = permutedims(V, (1, 3, 2, 4))
    
    # Scaled dot-product attention
    scores = batched_mul(Q, permutedims(K, (1, 2, 4, 3))) * mha.scale
    
    # Apply causal mask
    mask = mha.causal_mask[1:seq_len, 1:seq_len]
    scores = scores .* mask .- T(1e9) .* (1 .- mask)
    
    # Softmax attention weights
    attn_weights = softmax(scores, dims=4)
    
    # Apply attention dropout
    if mha.attention_dropout > 0
        attn_weights = dropout(attn_weights, mha.attention_dropout)
    end
    
    # Apply attention to values
    attn_output = batched_mul(attn_weights, V)
    
    # Concatenate heads
    attn_output = permutedims(attn_output, (1, 3, 2, 4))
    attn_output = reshape(attn_output, batch_size, seq_len, d_model)
    
    # Final projection
    output = attn_output * mha.W_o
    
    # Output dropout
    if mha.output_dropout > 0
        output = dropout(output, mha.output_dropout)
    end
    
    return output
end

"""
Advanced Feed Forward Network with GELU activation and proper initialization
"""
struct FeedForwardNetwork{T}
    W1::Matrix{T}
    b1::Vector{T}
    W2::Matrix{T}
    b2::Vector{T}
    dropout_rate::T
    
    function FeedForwardNetwork{T}(d_model::Int, d_ff::Int; dropout_rate::T=0.1f0) where T<:AbstractFloat
        # He initialization for GELU
        init_scale_1 = sqrt(T(2.0) / T(d_model))
        init_scale_2 = sqrt(T(2.0) / T(d_ff))
        
        W1 = randn(T, d_model, d_ff) * init_scale_1
        b1 = zeros(T, d_ff)
        W2 = randn(T, d_ff, d_model) * init_scale_2
        b2 = zeros(T, d_model)
        
        new{T}(W1, b1, W2, b2, dropout_rate)
    end
end

function gelu(x::T) where T<:AbstractFloat
    return T(0.5) * x * (1 + tanh(sqrt(T(2/π)) * (x + T(0.044715) * x^3)))
end

function forward(ffn::FeedForwardNetwork{T}, x::AbstractArray{T,3}) where T
    # First projection with GELU activation
    hidden = gelu.(x * ffn.W1 .+ reshape(ffn.b1, 1, 1, :))
    
    # Dropout
    if ffn.dropout_rate > 0
        hidden = dropout(hidden, ffn.dropout_rate)
    end
    
    # Second projection
    output = hidden * ffn.W2 .+ reshape(ffn.b2, 1, 1, :)
    
    return output
end

"""
Layer Normalization with learnable parameters
"""
struct LayerNorm{T}
    gamma::Vector{T}
    beta::Vector{T}
    eps::T
    
    function LayerNorm{T}(d_model::Int; eps::T=1e-5f0) where T<:AbstractFloat
        gamma = ones(T, d_model)
        beta = zeros(T, d_model)
        new{T}(gamma, beta, eps)
    end
end

function forward(ln::LayerNorm{T}, x::AbstractArray{T,3}) where T
    # Compute mean and variance along the last dimension
    μ = mean(x, dims=3)
    σ² = var(x, dims=3, mean=μ)
    
    # Normalize
    x_norm = (x .- μ) ./ sqrt.(σ² .+ ln.eps)
    
    # Scale and shift
    return x_norm .* reshape(ln.gamma, 1, 1, :) .+ reshape(ln.beta, 1, 1, :)
end

"""
Complete Transformer Block with pre-layer normalization
"""
struct TransformerBlock{T}
    self_attention::MultiHeadSelfAttention{T}
    feed_forward::FeedForwardNetwork{T}
    ln1::LayerNorm{T}
    ln2::LayerNorm{T}
    
    function TransformerBlock{T}(d_model::Int, num_heads::Int, d_ff::Int; 
                                attention_dropout::T=0.1f0,
                                ffn_dropout::T=0.1f0,
                                max_seq_len::Int=8192) where T<:AbstractFloat
        self_attention = MultiHeadSelfAttention{T}(d_model, num_heads, 
                                                  attention_dropout=attention_dropout,
                                                  max_seq_len=max_seq_len)
        feed_forward = FeedForwardNetwork{T}(d_model, d_ff, dropout_rate=ffn_dropout)
        ln1 = LayerNorm{T}(d_model)
        ln2 = LayerNorm{T}(d_model)
        
        new{T}(self_attention, feed_forward, ln1, ln2)
    end
end

function forward(block::TransformerBlock{T}, x::AbstractArray{T,3}) where T
    # Pre-layer normalization for self-attention
    ln1_output = forward(block.ln1, x)
    attn_output = forward(block.self_attention, ln1_output)
    
    # Residual connection
    x = x + attn_output
    
    # Pre-layer normalization for feed-forward
    ln2_output = forward(block.ln2, x)
    ffn_output = forward(block.feed_forward, ln2_output)
    
    # Residual connection
    x = x + ffn_output
    
    return x
end

"""
Positional Encoding with learned and sinusoidal components
"""
struct PositionalEncoding{T}
    learned_embeddings::Matrix{T}
    sinusoidal_embeddings::Matrix{T}
    max_seq_len::Int
    d_model::Int
    
    function PositionalEncoding{T}(max_seq_len::Int, d_model::Int) where T<:AbstractFloat
        # Learned positional embeddings
        learned_embeddings = randn(T, max_seq_len, d_model) * T(0.02)
        
        # Sinusoidal positional embeddings
        sinusoidal_embeddings = zeros(T, max_seq_len, d_model)
        for pos in 1:max_seq_len
            for i in 1:2:d_model
                div_term = exp(T(i-1) * -(log(T(10000.0)) / T(d_model)))
                sinusoidal_embeddings[pos, i] = sin(T(pos-1) * div_term)
                if i+1 <= d_model
                    sinusoidal_embeddings[pos, i+1] = cos(T(pos-1) * div_term)
                end
            end
        end
        
        new{T}(learned_embeddings, sinusoidal_embeddings, max_seq_len, d_model)
    end
end

function forward(pe::PositionalEncoding{T}, seq_len::Int) where T
    learned_pos = pe.learned_embeddings[1:seq_len, :]
    sinusoidal_pos = pe.sinusoidal_embeddings[1:seq_len, :]
    
    # Combine learned and sinusoidal (weighted combination)
    return T(0.7) * learned_pos + T(0.3) * sinusoidal_pos
end

        init_scale = sqrt(T(1.0) / T(d_model))
        embeddings = randn(T, vocab_size, d_model) * init_scale
        
        new{T}(embeddings, vocab_size, d_model)
    end
end

"""
Complete GPT-5 Architecture Implementation
"""
struct GPT5Model{T}
    vocab_size::Int
    d_model::Int
    num_layers::Int
    num_heads::Int
    d_ff::Int
    max_seq_len::Int
    
    token_embedding::TokenEmbedding{T}
    positional_encoding::PositionalEncoding{T}
    transformer_blocks::Vector{TransformerBlock{T}}
    final_layer_norm::LayerNorm{T}
    output_projection::Matrix{T}
    
    function GPT5Model{T}(vocab_size::Int, 
                         d_model::Int=4096, 
                         num_layers::Int=32, 
                         num_heads::Int=32, 
                         d_ff::Int=16384,
                         max_seq_len::Int=8192;
                         attention_dropout::T=0.1f0,
                         ffn_dropout::T=0.1f0) where T<:AbstractFloat
        
        token_embedding = TokenEmbedding{T}(vocab_size, d_model)
        positional_encoding = PositionalEncoding{T}(max_seq_len, d_model)
        
        transformer_blocks = [TransformerBlock{T}(d_model, num_heads, d_ff,
                                                 attention_dropout=attention_dropout,
                                                 ffn_dropout=ffn_dropout,
                                                 max_seq_len=max_seq_len) 
                             for _ in 1:num_layers]
        
        final_layer_norm = LayerNorm{T}(d_model)
        
        # Output projection to vocabulary (tied with input embeddings)
        output_projection = token_embedding.embeddings'
        
        new{T}(vocab_size, d_model, num_layers, num_heads, d_ff, max_seq_len,
               token_embedding, positional_encoding, transformer_blocks,
               final_layer_norm, output_projection)
    end
end

function forward(model::GPT5Model{T}, token_ids::AbstractVector{Int}) where T
    seq_len = length(token_ids)
    
    # Token embeddings
    token_emb = forward(model.token_embedding, token_ids)
    
    # Positional embeddings
    pos_emb = forward(model.positional_encoding, seq_len)
    
    # Combine embeddings
    x = reshape(token_emb + pos_emb, 1, seq_len, model.d_model)
    
    # Pass through transformer blocks
    for block in model.transformer_blocks
        x = forward(block, x)
    end
    
    # Final layer normalization
    x = forward(model.final_layer_norm, x)
    
    # Output projection
    logits = reshape(x, seq_len, model.d_model) * model.output_projection
    
    return logits
end

Advanced Training Infrastructure

"""
Cross-entropy loss with label smoothing
"""
function cross_entropy_loss_with_smoothing(logits::AbstractMatrix{T}, 
                                          targets::AbstractVector{Int}, 
                                          label_smoothing::T=0.1f0) where T<:AbstractFloat
    vocab_size = size(logits, 2)
    seq_len = length(targets)
    
    # Convert to one-hot with label smoothing
    smooth_targets = fill(label_smoothing / T(vocab_size - 1), seq_len, vocab_size)
    for i in 1:seq_len
        smooth_targets[i, targets[i]] = 1 - label_smoothing + label_smoothing / T(vocab_size - 1)
    end
    
    # Compute softmax probabilities
    probs = softmax(logits, dims=2)
    
    # Cross-entropy loss
    loss = -sum(smooth_targets .* log.(probs .+ T(1e-8))) / T(seq_len)
    
    return loss
end

"""
Training step with gradient computation and optimization
"""
function training_step!(trainer::GPT5Trainer{T}, 
                       input_ids::AbstractVector{Int},
                       target_ids::AbstractVector{Int}) where T
    
    # Forward pass with gradient tracking
    loss, grads = Zygote.withgradient(trainer.model) do model
        logits = forward(model, input_ids)
        cross_entropy_loss_with_smoothing(logits, target_ids)
    end
    
    # Gradient clipping
    grad_norm = norm([norm(g) for g in values(grads) if g !== nothing])
    if grad_norm > trainer.gradient_clip_norm
        scale_factor = trainer.gradient_clip_norm / grad_norm
        for (key, grad) in pairs(grads)
            if grad !== nothing
                grads[key] = grad * scale_factor
            end
        end
    end
    
    # Apply optimizer
    Optimisers.update!(trainer.optimizer, trainer.model, grads)
    
    return loss
end

function nucleus_sampling(logits::AbstractVector{T}, p::T=0.9f0) where T<:AbstractFloat
    probs = softmax(logits)
    sorted_indices = sortperm(probs, rev=true)
    sorted_probs = probs[sorted_indices]
    
    # Find nucleus
    cumsum_probs = cumsum(sorted_probs)
    nucleus_size = findfirst(x -> x >= p, cumsum_probs)
    
    if nucleus_size === nothing
        nucleus_size = length(probs)
    end
    
    # Sample from nucleus
    nucleus_indices = sorted_indices[1:nucleus_size]
    nucleus_probs = sorted_probs[1:nucleus_size]
    nucleus_probs = nucleus_probs ./ sum(nucleus_probs)
    
    return sample(nucleus_indices, Weights(nucleus_probs))
end

function generate_text(generator::TextGenerator{T}, 
                      prompt_ids::AbstractVector{Int}, 
                      max_length::Int=100;
                      temperature::T=1.0f0,
                      top_p::T=0.9f0) where T<:AbstractFloat
    
    generated_ids = copy(prompt_ids)
    
    for _ in 1:(max_length - length(prompt_ids))
        # Get logits for next token
        logits = forward(generator.model, generated_ids)
        next_token_logits = logits[end, :] ./ temperature
        
        # Sample next token
        next_token = nucleus_sampling(next_token_logits, top_p)
        push!(generated_ids, next_token)
        
        # Stop if end token (assuming token 0 is end token)
        if next_token == 1  # Assuming 1 is end-of-sequence token
            break
        end
    end
    
    return generated_ids
end

"""
Model Parallelism for large models
"""
struct ModelParallelGPT5{T}
    layer_shards::Vector{Vector{TransformerBlock{T}}}
    embedding_shard::Tuple{TokenEmbedding{T}, PositionalEncoding{T}}
    output_shard::Tuple{LayerNorm{T}, Matrix{T}}
    num_devices::Int
    
    function ModelParallelGPT5{T}(base_model::GPT5Model{T}, num_devices::Int=4) where T<:AbstractFloat
        layers_per_device = div(base_model.num_layers, num_devices)
        
        layer_shards = []
        for device in 1:num_devices
            start_idx = (device - 1) * layers_per_device + 1
            end_idx = device == num_devices ? base_model.num_layers : device * layers_per_device
            push!(layer_shards, base_model.transformer_blocks[start_idx:end_idx])
        end
        
        embedding_shard = (base_model.token_embedding, base_model.positional_encoding)
        output_shard = (base_model.final_layer_norm, base_model.output_projection)
        
        new{T}(layer_shards, embedding_shard, output_shard, num_devices)
    end
end

"""
Data Pipeline for Training

struct DataLoader
    data::Vector{Vector{Int}}
    batch_size::Int
    seq_length::Int
    current_index::Int
    
    function DataLoader(data::Vector{Vector{Int}}, batch_size::Int, seq_length::Int)
        new(data, batch_size, seq_length, 1)

function get_batch(loader::DataLoader)
    batch_data = []
    
    for _ in 1:loader.batch_size
        if loader.current_index > length(loader.data)
            loader.current_index = 1  # Reset to beginning
        end
        
        sequence = loader.data[loader.current_index]
        if length(sequence) >= loader.seq_length + 1
            start_idx = rand(1:(length(sequence) - loader.seq_length))
            input_seq = sequence[start_idx:(start_idx + loader.seq_length - 1)]
            target_seq = sequence[(start_idx + 1):(start_idx + loader.seq_length)]
            push!(batch_data, (input_seq, target_seq))
        end
        
        loader.current_index += 1
    end
    
    return batch_data
end

"""
Advanced Optimization Schedules
"""
struct CosineAnnealingSchedule{T}
    initial_lr::T
    min_lr::T
    total_steps::Int
    warmup_steps::Int
    
    function CosineAnnealingSchedule{T}(initial_lr::T, min_lr::T, 
                                       total_steps::Int, warmup_steps::Int=0) where T<:AbstractFloat
        new{T}(initial_lr, min_lr, total_steps, warmup_steps)
    end
end

function get_learning_rate(schedule::CosineAnnealingSchedule{T}, step::Int) where T
    if step <= schedule.warmup_steps
        # Linear warmup
        return schedule.initial_lr * T(step) / T(schedule.warmup_steps)
    else
        # Cosine annealing
        progress = T(step - schedule.warmup_steps) / T(schedule.total_steps - schedule.warmup_steps)
        return schedule.min_lr + (schedule.initial_lr - schedule.min_lr) * 
               T(0.5) * (1 + cos(π * progress))
    end
end

"""
Memory-efficient Gradient Checkpointing
"""
struct GradientCheckpoint
    forward_cache::Dict{Int, Any}
    memory_limit::Int
    
    function GradientCheckpoint(memory_limit::Int=1000)
        new(Dict{Int, Any}(), memory_limit)
    end
end

function checkpoint_forward(checkpoint::GradientCheckpoint, 
                          layer_idx::Int, 
                          computation::Function, 
                          input::Any)
    if length(checkpoint.forward_cache) >= checkpoint.memory_limit
        # Clear oldest entries
        oldest_key = minimum(keys(checkpoint.forward_cache))
        delete!(checkpoint.forward_cache, oldest_key)
    end
    
    result = computation(input)
    checkpoint.forward_cache[layer_idx] = (input, result)
    
    return result
end

function calculate_perplexity(model::GPT5Model{T}, 
                            validation_data::Vector{Vector{Int}}) where T<:AbstractFloat
    total_loss = T(0.0)
    total_tokens = 0
    
    for sequence in validation_data
        if length(sequence) > 1
            input_ids = sequence[1:end-1]
            target_ids = sequence[2:end]
            
            logits = forward(model, input_ids)
            loss = cross_entropy_loss_with_smoothing(logits, target_ids, T(0.0))
            
            total_loss += loss * length(target_ids)
            total_tokens += length(target_ids)
        end
    end
    
    avg_loss = total_loss / T(total_tokens)
    return exp(avg_loss)
end

function extract_block_weights(block::TransformerBlock{T}) where T
    return Dict(
        "attention" => Dict(
            "W_q" => block.self_attention.W_q,
            "W_k" => block.self_attention.W_k,
            "W_v" => block.self_attention.W_v,
            "W_o" => block.self_attention.W_o
        ),
        "ffn" => Dict(
            "W1" => block.feed_forward.W1,
            "b1" => block.feed_forward.b1,
            "W2" => block.feed_forward.W2,
            "b2" => block.feed_forward.b2
        ),
        "ln1" => (block.ln1.gamma, block.ln1.beta),
        "ln2" => (block.ln2.gamma, block.ln2.beta)
    )
end

"""
Complete Training Loop
"""
function train_gpt5(model::GPT5Model{T}, 
                   train_data::Vector{Vector{Int}},
                   validation_data::Vector{Vector{Int}};
                   num_epochs::Int=10,
                   batch_size::Int=32,
                   seq_length::Int=512,
                   learning_rate::T=3e-4f0,
                   save_every::Int=1000,
                   eval_every::Int=500) where T<:AbstractFloat
    
    trainer = GPT5Trainer{T}(model, learning_rate=learning_rate)
    data_loader = DataLoader(train_data, batch_size, seq_length)
    
    total_steps = num_epochs * div(length(train_data), batch_size)
    schedule = CosineAnnealingSchedule{T}(learning_rate, learning_rate * T(0.1), 
                                         total_steps, div(total_steps, 10))
    
    step = 0
    best_perplexity = T(Inf)
    
    println("Starting training...")
    println("Total steps: $total_steps")
    println("Model parameters: $(count_parameters(model))")
    
    progress = Progress(total_steps)
    
    for epoch in 1:num_epochs
        println("Epoch $epoch/$num_epochs")
        
        epoch_loss = T(0.0)
        epoch_steps = 0
        
        while step < total_steps
            batch = get_batch(data_loader)
            batch_loss = T(0.0)
            
            for (input_ids, target_ids) in batch
                # Update learning rate
                current_lr = get_learning_rate(schedule, step)
                trainer.optimizer = Optimisers.adjust!(trainer.optimizer, lr=current_lr)
                
                # Training step
                loss = training_step!(trainer, input_ids, target_ids)
                batch_loss += loss
                
                step += 1
                epoch_steps += 1
                
                next!(progress, showvalues=[
                    (:epoch, epoch),
                    (:step, step),
                    (:loss, round(loss, digits=4)),
                    (:lr, round(current_lr, digits=8))
                ])
                
                if step % eval_every == 0
                    # Evaluation
                    perplexity = calculate_perplexity(model, validation_data)
                    println("\nValidation perplexity: $(round(perplexity, digits=2))")
                    
                    if perplexity < best_perplexity
                        best_perplexity = perplexity
                        save_model(model, "best_gpt5_model.bson")
                        println("New best model saved!")
                    end
                end
                
                if step % save_every == 0
                    save_model(model, "gpt5_checkpoint_step_$step.bson")
                end
                
                if step >= total_steps
                    break
                end
            end
            
            epoch_loss += batch_loss / length(batch)
        end
        
        avg_epoch_loss = epoch_loss / epoch_steps
        println("Epoch $epoch completed. Average loss: $(round(avg_epoch_loss, digits=4))")
    end
    
    println("Training completed!")
    return model, trainer
end

function count_parameters(model::GPT5Model{T}) where T
    total = 0
    
    # Token embeddings
    total += length(model.token_embedding.embeddings)
    
    # Positional embeddings
    total += length(model.positional_encoding.learned_embeddings)
    
    # Transformer blocks
    for block in model.transformer_blocks
        total += length(block.self_attention.W_q)
        total += length(block.self_attention.W_k)
        total += length(block.self_attention.W_v)
        total += length(block.self_attention.W_o)

        total += length(block.feed_forward.W2)

        total += length(block.ln1.gamma)
        total += length(block.ln1.beta)
        total += length(block.ln2.gamma)
        total += length(block.ln2.beta)
    end
    
    # Final layer norm
    total += length(model.final_layer_norm.gamma)
    total += length(model.final_layer_norm.beta)
    
    return total
end

## A kód főbb komponensei

A bemutatott kód egy összetett mesterséges intelligencia rendszer, amely az alábbi fő elemekből áll [4][5]:

A kód egy 32 rétegű, 4096 dimenziós modellt valósít meg, 32 attention fejjel és 8192 tokenes maximális szekvenciahosszal [1][7]. Ez összesen több milliárd paramétert jelent.

**Tanítási infrastruktúra:**
- Adam optimalizáló gradiens vágással

- Label smoothing keresztentrópia veszteségfüggvény

**Szöveggenerálás:**

**Fejlett funkciók:**

- Adatbetöltő pipeline

- Modell mentés/betöltés BSON formátumban

## Julia nyelv választása

A Julia nyelvet tudományos gépi tanuláshoz választották, mivel [2][3]:
- Kifejezetten numerikus számításokhoz tervezték
- JIT (Just-in-Time) fordítással gyors végrehajtást biztosít
- Python-szerű szintaxissal, de C-hez hasonló teljesítménnyel rendelkezik
- Beépített párhuzamosítási támogatással bír

Ez a kód egy **oktatási/kutatási célú implementáció**, amely bemutatja, hogyan épül fel egy modern transformer alapú nyelvi modell az alapoktól [8][7].

using JSON3
using Unicode
using StatsBase

"""
Complete Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE) Tokenizer Implementation
Based on the GPT tokenization methodology
"""

struct BPETokenizer
    vocab::Dict{String, Int}
    inverse_vocab::Dict{Int, String}
    merges::Vector{Tuple{String, String}}
    special_tokens::Dict{String, Int}
    vocab_size::Int
    
    function BPETokenizer(vocab_file::String, merges_file::String)
        # Load vocabulary
        vocab_data = JSON3.read(read(vocab_file, String))
        vocab = Dict{String, Int}(k => v for (k, v) in vocab_data)
        inverse_vocab = Dict{Int, String}(v => k for (k, v) in vocab)
        
        # Load merges
        merge_lines = readlines(merges_file)
        merges = []
        for line in merge_lines[2:end]  # Skip header
            if !isempty(strip(line))
                parts = split(strip(line))
                if length(parts) >= 2
                    push!(merges, (parts[1], parts[2]))
                end
            end
        end
        
        # Special tokens
        special_tokens = Dict(
            "<|startoftext|>" => 50256,
            "<|endoftext|>" => 50257,
            "<|unk|>" => 50258,
            "<|pad|>" => 50259
        )
        
        vocab_size = length(vocab) + length(special_tokens)
        
        # Add special tokens to vocab
        for (token, id) in special_tokens
            vocab[token] = id
            inverse_vocab[id] = token
        end
        
        new(vocab, inverse_vocab, merges, special_tokens, vocab_size)
    end
    
    function BPETokenizer(vocab_size::Int=50260)
        # Create minimal tokenizer for testing
        vocab = Dict{String, Int}()
        inverse_vocab = Dict{Int, String}()
        
        # Basic ASCII characters
        for i in 0:255
            char = string(Char(i))
            vocab[char] = i + 1
            inverse_vocab[i + 1] = char
        end
        
        # Common subwords (simplified)
        common_subwords = [
            "the", "and", "ing", "ion", "tion", "er", "re", "an", "ed", "nd",
            "to", "en", "ti", "es", "or", "te", "of", "be", "at", "se", "th",
            "in", "al", "it", "ar", "ou", "is", "on", "ll", "as", "st", "el"
        ]
        
        next_id = 257
        for subword in common_subwords
            if next_id <= vocab_size - 10  # Reserve space for special tokens
                vocab[subword] = next_id
                inverse_vocab[next_id] = subword
                next_id += 1
            end
        end
        
        # Special tokens
        special_tokens = Dict(
            "<|startoftext|>" => vocab_size - 3,
            "<|endoftext|>" => vocab_size - 2,
            "<|unk|>" => vocab_size - 1,
            "<|pad|>" => vocab_size
        )
        
        for (token, id) in special_tokens
            vocab[token] = id
            inverse_vocab[id] = token
        end

        new(vocab, inverse_vocab, merges, special_tokens, vocab_size)
    end
end

"""
Get pairs of consecutive symbols in a word
"""
function get_pairs(word::Vector{String})
    pairs = Set{Tuple{String, String}}()
    
    if length(word) < 2
        return pairs
    end
    
    for i in 1:(length(word) - 1)
        push!(pairs, (word[i], word[i + 1]))
    end
    
    return pairs
end

"""
Apply BPE merges to a word
"""
function apply_bpe(tokenizer::BPETokenizer, word::String)
    if length(word) <= 1
        return [word]
    end
    
    # Split word into characters
    word_chars = collect(word)
    word_tokens = [string(c) for c in word_chars]
    
    # Apply merges iteratively
    while length(word_tokens) > 1
        pairs = get_pairs(word_tokens)
        
        if isempty(pairs)
            break
        end
        
        # Find the merge with highest priority (earliest in merge list)
        best_merge = nothing
        best_merge_idx = typemax(Int)
        
        for (merge_idx, (first, second)) in enumerate(tokenizer.merges)
            if (first, second) in pairs && merge_idx < best_merge_idx
                best_merge = (first, second)
                best_merge_idx = merge_idx
            end
        end
        
        if best_merge === nothing
            break
        end
        
        # Apply the best merge
        first, second = best_merge
        new_word_tokens = String[]
        i = 1
        
        while i <= length(word_tokens)
            if i < length(word_tokens) && 
               word_tokens[i] == first && 
               word_tokens[i + 1] == second
                push!(new_word_tokens, first * second)
                i += 2
            else
                push!(new_word_tokens, word_tokens[i])
                i += 1
            end
        end
        
        word_tokens = new_word_tokens
    end
    
    return word_tokens
end

"""
Preprocess text for tokenization
"""
function preprocess_text(text::String)
    # Convert to lowercase and handle whitespace
    text = lowercase(text)
    
    # Add spaces around punctuation
    punctuation = "!\"#\$%&'()*+,-./:;<=>?@[\\]^_`{|}~"
    for p in punctuation
        text = replace(text, p => " $p ")
    end
    
    # Normalize whitespace
    text = replace(text, r"\s+" => " ")
    text = strip(text)
    
    return text
end

"""
Encode text to token IDs
"""
function encode(tokenizer::BPETokenizer, text::String; add_special_tokens::Bool=true)
    if isempty(text)
        return Int[]
    end
    
    token_ids = Int[]
    
    # Add start token
    if add_special_tokens
        push!(token_ids, tokenizer.special_tokens["<|startoftext|>"])
    end
    
    # Preprocess text
    preprocessed = preprocess_text(text)
    
    # Split into words
    words = split(preprocessed)
    
    for word in words
        # Apply BPE to word
        bpe_tokens = apply_bpe(tokenizer, word)
        
        # Convert tokens to IDs
        for token in bpe_tokens
            if haskey(tokenizer.vocab, token)
                push!(token_ids, tokenizer.vocab[token])
            else
                # Handle unknown tokens
                # Split into characters and encode each
                for char in token
                    char_str = string(char)
                    if haskey(tokenizer.vocab, char_str)
                        push!(token_ids, tokenizer.vocab[char_str])
                    else
                        push!(token_ids, tokenizer.special_tokens["<|unk|>"])
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    # Add end token
    if add_special_tokens
        push!(token_ids, tokenizer.special_tokens["<|endoftext|>"])
    end
    
    return token_ids
end

"""
Decode token IDs to text
"""
function decode(tokenizer::BPETokenizer, token_ids::Vector{Int}; skip_special_tokens::Bool=true)
    tokens = String[]
    
    for token_id in token_ids
        if haskey(tokenizer.inverse_vocab, token_id)
            token = tokenizer.inverse_vocab[token_id]
            
            # Skip special tokens if requested
            if skip_special_tokens && token in keys(tokenizer.special_tokens)
                continue
            end
            
            push!(tokens, token)
        end
    end
    
    # Join tokens and clean up
    text = join(tokens, "")
    
    # Fix spacing around punctuation
    text = replace(text, r"\s+([!\"#\$%&'()*+,-./:;<=>?@\[\\\]^_`{|}~])" => s"\1")
    text = replace(text, r"([!\"#\$%&'()*+,-./:;<=>?@\[\\\]^_`{|}~])\s+" => s"\1 ")
    
    # Normalize whitespace
    text = replace(text, r"\s+" => " ")
    text = strip(text)
    
    return text
end

"""
Train BPE tokenizer from text corpus
"""
function train_bpe_tokenizer(corpus::Vector{String}, 
                           vocab_size::Int=50000;
                           min_frequency::Int=2)
    
    println("Training BPE tokenizer...")
    println("Corpus size: $(length(corpus)) documents")
    println("Target vocab size: $vocab_size")
    
    # Initialize vocabulary with characters
    vocab = Dict{String, Int}()
    char_counts = Dict{String, Int}()
    
    # Count character frequencies
    for text in corpus
        for char in text
            char_str = string(char)
            char_counts[char_str] = get(char_counts, char_str, 0) + 1
        end
    end
    
    # Add frequent characters to initial vocabulary
    next_id = 1
    for (char, count) in char_counts
        if count >= min_frequency
            vocab[char] = next_id
            next_id += 1
        end
    end
    
    println("Initial vocabulary size: $(length(vocab)) characters")
    
    # Prepare word frequency dictionary
    word_freqs = Dict{String, Int}()
    
    for text in corpus
        preprocessed = preprocess_text(text)
        words = split(preprocessed)
        
        for word in words
            # Represent word as space-separated characters
            char_word = join([string(c) for c in word], " ") * " </w>"
            word_freqs[char_word] = get(word_freqs, char_word, 0) + 1
        end
    end
    
    println("Unique words: $(length(word_freqs))")
    
    # Iteratively merge most frequent pairs
    merges = Tuple{String, String}[]
    
    target_merges = vocab_size - length(vocab) - 10  # Reserve space for special tokens
    
    for merge_step in 1:target_merges
        if merge_step % 1000 == 0
            println("Merge step: $merge_step")
        end
        
        # Count all pairs
        pair_counts = Dict{Tuple{String, String}, Int}()
        
        for (word, freq) in word_freqs
            word_tokens = split(word)
            word_pairs = get_pairs(word_tokens)
            
            for pair in word_pairs
                pair_counts[pair] = get(pair_counts, pair, 0) + freq
            end
        end
        
        if isempty(pair_counts)
            break
        end
        
        # Find most frequent pair
        best_pair = argmax(pair_counts)
        best_count = pair_counts[best_pair]
        
        if best_count < min_frequency
            break
        end
        
        # Add merge
        push!(merges, best_pair)
        
        # Add merged token to vocabulary
        merged_token = best_pair[1] * best_pair[2]
        vocab[merged_token] = next_id
        next_id += 1
        
        # Update word frequencies with merged token
        new_word_freqs = Dict{String, Int}()
        
        for (word, freq) in word_freqs
            new_word = replace(word, "$(best_pair[1]) $(best_pair[2])" => merged_token)
            new_word_freqs[new_word] = freq
        end
        
        word_freqs = new_word_freqs
    end
    
    println("Training completed!")
    println("Final vocabulary size: $(length(vocab))")
    println("Number of merges: $(length(merges))")
    
    # Create inverse vocabulary
    inverse_vocab = Dict{Int, String}(v => k for (k, v) in vocab)
    
    # Add special tokens
    special_tokens = Dict(
        "<|startoftext|>" => next_id,
        "<|endoftext|>" => next_id + 1,
        "<|unk|>" => next_id + 2,
        "<|pad|>" => next_id + 3
    )
    
    for (token, id) in special_tokens
        vocab[token] = id
        inverse_vocab[id] = token
    end
    
    final_vocab_size = length(vocab)
    
    return BPETokenizer(vocab, inverse_vocab, merges, special_tokens, final_vocab_size)
end

"""
Save tokenizer to files
"""
function save_tokenizer(tokenizer::BPETokenizer, vocab_file::String, merges_file::String)
    # Save vocabulary
    JSON3.write(vocab_file, tokenizer.vocab)
    
    # Save merges
    open(merges_file, "w") do f
        println(f, "#version: 0.2")
        for (first, second) in tokenizer.merges
            println(f, "$first $second")
        end
    end
    
    println("Tokenizer saved to $vocab_file and $merges_file")
end

"""
Load tokenizer from files
"""
function load_tokenizer(vocab_file::String, merges_file::String)
    return BPETokenizer(vocab_file, merges_file)
end

# Example usage and testing
function test_tokenizer()
    println("Testing BPE Tokenizer...")
    
    # Create a simple tokenizer
    tokenizer = BPETokenizer(1000)
    
    # Test encoding and decoding
    test_text = "Hello, world! This is a test of the BPE tokenizer implementation."
    println("Original text: $test_text")
    
    token_ids = encode(tokenizer, test_text)
    println("Token IDs: $token_ids")
    
    decoded_text = decode(tokenizer, token_ids)
    println("Decoded text: $decoded_text")
    
    # Test with longer text
    longer_text = """
    The transformer architecture has revolutionized natural language processing.
    It uses self-attention mechanisms to process sequences in parallel,
    making it much more efficient than recurrent neural networks.
    """
    
    longer_token_ids = encode(tokenizer, longer_text)
    println("Longer text token count: $(length(longer_token_ids))")
    
    decoded_longer = decode(tokenizer, longer_token_ids)
    println("Longer text decoded successfully: $(decoded_longer == strip(longer_text))")
    
    return tokenizer
end

# Export functions
export BPETokenizer, encode, decode, train_bpe_tokenizer
